summary: Iteration 2 verified the two new features (Lavori CRUD + Preventivo PDF) plus regression on existing endpoints and UI. 17/17 backend pytest cases pass, all target frontend flows pass. Note: backend required a supervisor restart at test start because the in-memory Tariffe class had stale attribute lookups after the schema was updated (calcola_costi referenced attribute manutenzione_motore_base that no longer exists in the updated Tariffe model). After restart everything worked. All UI flows for lavori dialog (create/edit/delete), PDF download button (both row-level btn-pdf-{id} and form-level btn-download-pdf), and 'Salva il cliente per poter aggiungere lo storico lavori' placeholder verified end-to-end.

minor.issue: After Tariffe schema evolution the running backend process kept a stale calcola_costi reference that raised AttributeError: 'Tariffe' object has no attribute 'manutenzione_motore_base'. Fixed by 'supervisorctl restart backend' — hot-reload had not picked up the change. Not reproducible on fresh boot. Recommend adding pytest smoke on POST /api/clienti as part of CI.

issues: React dev overlay occasionally shows 'ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications.' — benign CRA/Radix-known warning triggered by Sheet + Dialog resize animations. Does not affect functionality. Consider swallowing via window.onerror handler for the dev overlay if it distracts stakeholders during demos.

passed_tests_backend: POST /api/lavori creates lavoro (returns id, created_at, tipo, costo, stato)
PUT /api/lavori/{id} updates costo+stato, GET verifies persistence
DELETE /api/lavori/{id} removes and GET confirms removal
GET /api/clienti/{id}/preventivo.pdf -> application/pdf, attachment CD, %PDF header, size>1500 bytes
passed_tests_frontend: Row has 3 action buttons: btn-pdf-{id}, btn-edit-{id}, btn-delete-{id}
Click btn-edit opens ClienteForm sheet; data-testid=lavori-section visible
btn-download-pdf visible in form for existing cliente with correct href
Fill lavoro form (data, tipo select, descrizione, costo, stato select, materiali) and Save triggers toast 'Lavoro aggiunto' and creates row (lavoro-row-{id})
btn-edit-lavoro-{id} opens dialog pre-filled (costo=320 verified), save updates value (450)
New cliente (btn-nuovo-cliente) shows placeholder 'Salva il cliente per poter aggiungere lo storico lavori.'
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has 764 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider splitting into routers/clienti.py, routers/lavori.py, routers/pdf.py, and models.py for maintainability.

get_tariffe_doc() rehydrates a Tariffe(**doc) but doc may contain legacy keys (extra='ignore' handles this). However any DB doc missing a NEW field will silently use the default, potentially masking migration issues. Consider an explicit migration or a version field.

PDF endpoint sets Content-Disposition using un-escaped cognome/nome — if a client name contains a comma or non-ASCII characters the header could be malformed in some clients. Use urllib.parse.quote and RFC 5987 filename* form for safety.
LavoriSection.load() has no error handling: axios rejection is unhandled and would leave loading=true forever if the endpoint fails.
Delete lavoro uses window.confirm() (native), while cliente delete uses shadcn AlertDialog. Inconsistent UX — recommend unifying with AlertDialog.
ClienteForm imports { API } from '@/lib/api' but if REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is missing at build time, API links would break silently — fine given .env is provisioned but flagging.
Lavoro model: 'data' is a plain string (YYYY-MM-DD) with no server-side validation; a malformed date would still be accepted and only fail during PDF/sort. Consider Pydantic date validation.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 test cliente ('TEST_Mario TEST_Verdi') during pytest and deleted at teardown; UI test created a lavoro on the first existing cliente (id e9595648-...) and deleted it at end. No residual test data left in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend Tariffe collection may have legacy fields due to prior iterations; the model uses extra='ignore' so it's transparent. If POST /api/clienti fails with AttributeError on Tariffe, restart backend to refresh the reload. Test file uses xdist loadscope automatically via /app/backend/pytest.ini; run: `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_lavori_pdf.py -v`.
rca_of_the_issue: Initial POST /api/clienti failed with 500 because backend calcola_costi referenced t.manutenzione_motore_base which no longer exists on the current Tariffe model. Uvicorn hot-reload apparently missed the change (or the server was launched before the edit). Fix: `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`. Not a code bug — a runtime staleness issue. Recommend adding smoke test to CI to detect early.
